summary: V0.3A On-Prem Windows Discovery Package verified end-to-end. Added /app/backend/tests/test_edge_v2a_discovery.py (8 new tests) covering: (a) OPEN register when no tokens minted (TEST-EDGE-OPEN succeeds with no token), (b) config still exposes action_allowlist(6) + prohibited_actions(9), (c) POST /edge-v2/enrollment-tokens mints ENROLL- prefixed token, (d) after mint, register WITHOUT token -> 401, (e) register WITH token -> 200 and single-use enforced (reuse returns 401 while another unused token keeps gate ON), (f) full discovery lifecycle: register REAL agent with token -> HMAC-signed heartbeat (REAL_ONLINE) -> operator enqueues DISCOVER_CAPABILITIES -> signed poll DISPATCHED -> signed result with realistic report payload (px300 unreachable @ 192.168.0.200 host, CWS/hot-folders/jobflow/london_bc all UNKNOWN/false, summary flags UNKNOWN, capability_matrix[CONNECT]) -> GET /discovery/{agent}/latest has_report=true, fields.REAL_FIERY_BACKEND=='NOT_IMPLEMENTED', PX300_REACHABLE=false, embedded IP '192.168.0.200' REDACTED in stored/returned JSON; GET /discovery/{agent}/report returns {json,markdown} with markdown containing 'P2G_LONDON_DISCOVERY_REPORT' and 'REAL_FIERY_BACKEND = NOT_IMPLEMENTED', (g) SAFETY: APPLY_TEMPLATE -> 400 NOT_ALLOWLISTED, PRINT -> 403 PROHIBITED, CREATE_HOT_FOLDER -> 400 NOT_ALLOWLISTED, and signed poll confirms none of them were queued, (h) IDEMPOTENT enqueue stability: two PING enqueues with idempotency_key=k-stable both HTTP200 with queued:true, 2nd also idempotent:true, same action id. FULL REGRESSION executed via pytest across /app/backend/tests/: 74 passed + 1 skipped + 0 failed (prior 66 + 8 new). FRONTEND: /diagnostics loads with all required tiles (tile-edge-agent OFFLINE, tile-network UNREACHABLE, tile-cws/tile-hotfolders/tile-londonbc UNKNOWN, tile-real-backend NOT IMPLEMENTED), Capability Matrix section populated (from the seed discovery result my backend test posted), run-discovery + export-report buttons present, sidebar has Diagnostics link, clicking Run Read-Only Discovery with agent OFFLINE shows the exact error toast 'Edge agent is OFFLINE — start the agent on the London PC first.', 0 console errors. Regression pages /edge-agents /production /recipes /dashboard load with 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: production.py::edge_v2_register enrollment gating is TENANT+LOCATION-scoped and only ENFORCED when >=1 unused token exists in that tenant/location. That means: (1) after all minted tokens are consumed, gating auto-turns-OFF and registers become open again. This is BACKWARD COMPATIBLE per spec, but operators should be aware: to keep gating always-ON, at least one unused token must exist. Consider a tenant-level policy flag `enrollment_required=true` that forces gating even when zero unused tokens exist (defense-in-depth against silent policy erosion).

production.py::mint_enrollment_token accepts tenant_id/location_id from request body with defaults TEN-PRINT2GO/LOC-LONDON — there is NO auth check on this endpoint. In a multi-tenant deployment this must be gated by an operator/admin session so a rogue caller cannot mint tokens for other tenants. Not a V0.3A blocker (no user auth yet) but flag for V0.4.

production.py::_build_report/_report_md: correctly synthesise the discovery fields including REAL_FIERY_BACKEND='NOT_IMPLEMENTED' regardless of what the agent reports (server is the source of truth for this honesty flag). Good.

production.py::redact_ips: verified again — both key-based host redaction and embedded-IP regex substitution are applied to the stored result, so the 192.168.0.200 embedded in report.px300.host is not leaked back through /discovery/latest or /discovery/report.
production.py::edge_v2_enqueue: idempotent return now emits queued:true + idempotent:true with the same action id — confirmed twice (spec bug fix).
Diagnostics.jsx: hard-codes AGENT_ID='P2G-LONDON-EDGE-01'. Consider deriving from tenant/location context or a dropdown when multi-agent, but acceptable for V0.3A.
Diagnostics.jsx: exportReport does not surface an error toast if the GET fails (silent .data access). Minor observability nit.

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST-EDGE-* agents in prod_edge_agents (REAL kind) plus prod_enrollment_tokens entries. Also posted a SUCCEEDED DISCOVER_CAPABILITIES result on a TEST-EDGE-DISC-* agent, which is now visible in the /diagnostics UI's Capability Matrix. Test tokens self-consume (final cleanup step registers a throwaway agent to consume the last extra token so gating returns to open state and next runs of the suite still work).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression = 74 tests across backend_test.py (V0.1), test_production.py (V0.2), test_edge_v2.py (V0.3), test_edge_v2a_discovery.py (V0.3A). Enrollment tokens are matched by tenant+location and gating auto-enables only when >=1 unused token exists — ALWAYS test the open-register case FIRST in the suite. Single-use is only demonstrable while another unused token keeps the gate active (see test_a5 pattern: mint extra, consume main, attempt reuse). Discovery flow requires agent to be REAL_ONLINE via signed heartbeat before enqueue/result. The Frontend /diagnostics UI polls every 5s via /production/edge-v2/discovery/{agent}/latest for AGENT_ID='P2G-LONDON-EDGE-01' — capability matrix on-screen comes from whichever agent last posted a SUCCEEDED DISCOVER_CAPABILITIES result (currently a TEST-EDGE-DISC-* seed, not P2G-LONDON-EDGE-01, so the matrix rows here actually correspond to that seed's response; if the real London agent posts later, its report will supersede).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only nuance worth surfacing: enrollment gating is presence-based (>=1 unused token in tenant/location). A naive single-token 'single-use' test can spuriously pass reuse because consuming the only token turns gating back OFF. Fixed by minting an 'extra' unused token so the gate stays ON while asserting reuse rejection.
